# Fetch all search results with pagination

def fetch_all_products(query, page_limit=20, sort_by='+delivery_days'):
    page_index = 0
    all_res = []
    while True:
        res = apis.amazon.search_products(query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by=sort_by)
        # print minimal debug per page
        print('page', page_index, 'count', (len(res) if isinstance(res, list) else 'NA'), 'type', type(res))
        if isinstance(res, list):
            if not res:
                break
            all_res.extend(res)
            if len(res) < page_limit:
                # may still have more, but safer to continue until empty
                pass
        else:
            # assume dict with failure
            print('res', res)
            break
        page_index += 1
        if page_index > 50:
            break
    return all_res

import re
from math import isnan
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
# recompute thresholds
now = datetime.now()
weekday = now.weekday()
sat_delta = (5 - weekday) % 7
this_saturday = now.date() + timedelta(days=sat_delta)
leaving_day = this_saturday
deadline_day = leaving_day - timedelta(days=1)
end_of_deadline = datetime.combine(deadline_day, datetime.max.time())
max_delivery_seconds = (end_of_deadline - now).total_seconds()
max_days = max_delivery_seconds/86400
max_days_floor = int(max_days)  # floor
print('now', now.isoformat())
print('leaving_day', leaving_day)
print('deadline_day', deadline_day)
print('max_days', max_days, 'max_days_floor', max_days_floor)

lantern_kw = re.compile(r'\blantern\b', re.I)
chair_kw = re.compile(r'\bchair\b', re.I)
beach_kw = re.compile(r'\bbeach\b', re.I)

# Helper to text-search name/description/ product_type

    exp_y = int(card.get('expiry_year'))

    # Conservative: expired if (exp_y, exp_m) < (now.year, now.month)
